description: This Swift file defines a utility enum 'ToolResultTextFormatter' with static methods for formatting, parsing, and rendering tool result texts, especially if they are JSON formatted. It handles extracting specific data from JSON, rendering summaries for nodes, and sanitizing error messages.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main entry point that formats input text, checks if it resembles JSON, parses JSON, and renders appropriate output based on JSON content and tool name.

methods.name: looksLikeJSON
methods.description: Checks if a string looks like JSON starting with '{' or '['.

methods.name: renderJSON
methods.description: Dispatches JSON object to appropriate rendering as a dictionary or array.

methods.name: renderDictionary
methods.description: Renders JSON dictionary, handling status, error messages, node summaries, or other messages.

methods.name: renderNodesSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary string of nodes from JSON data, including connection status, platform, version, and pairing details.

methods.name: pairingDetail
methods.description: Determines whether a node requires pairing based on its data.

methods.name: firstString
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty string value for a list of keys from a dictionary.

methods.name: sanitizeError
methods.description: Cleans up error strings by removing agent/action info, trimming, and truncating if too long.
